lead.hed: U.S. and British forces sank the decommissioned frigate Klakring in the North Atlantic
lead.insight: U.S. 6th Fleet, posted on DVIDS: Exercise Atlantic Thunder 2026 ended Sept. 25 in the North Atlantic. Ships, aircraft, and a submarine from the United States and the United Kingdom sank the decommissioned guided-missile frigate ex-USS Klakring. USS Paul Ignatius fired an anti-surface Standard Missile 6. USS Massachusetts finished the hulk with a Mk 48 torpedo. The Royal Navy fired its Naval Strike Missile and Sea Venom. Official still from RAF Mildenhall, Sept. 21, shows the tanker crew that refueled the exercise.
lead.image_credit: Senior Airman Aidan Martinez Rosiere · DVIDS 9970026 · Public domain · 100th Air Refueling Wing airmen in front of a KC-135 before a refueling mission, RAF Mildenhall, England, Sept. 21, 2026.

political.hed: Four people were injured in a landing mishap aboard Eisenhower; the crew was recovered
political.insight: USNI News, posted overnight: four personnel were injured Monday in a landing mishap aboard USS Dwight D. Eisenhower. The crew of an unspecified two-seat aircraft assigned to Carrier Air Wing 3 ejected and was safely recovered. The story says it will be updated as more information comes in. Aircraft type and the extent of the injuries are not in the first report.

political.hed: A French artillery regiment is splitting its guns into pairs to survive drones
political.insight: Defense News, Tuesday, from Besançon: Col. Rémy Jaillet, who commands the 68th African Artillery Regiment, said the unit is reshuffling its 155 mm Caesar batteries from two four-gun sections into three two-gun sections. The fleet size stays the same for now. Jaillet said smaller, more dispersed units hold up better against counter-battery fire. He said the change is a trial at that regiment, not yet an Army-wide format.

political.hed: An essay says trauma-informed care can trap the people it means to heal
political.insight: Public Discourse, Tuesday: the essay says trauma-informed care promises to connect present behavior to past mistreatment, but its political corollary valorizes victimhood. Essay, not a clinical study and not a statute.

tech.hed: A just-war essay says annihilation sits outside the limits of war
tech.insight: Providence, Tuesday: the essay notes that churches prayed for peace on Sunday, seven months into the war with Iran, and that President Trump told Fox News he was weighing whether to blow the entire nation up. Argument about just-war limits, not a new strike report.

culture.hed: An essay says the new populists share a romantic distrust of institutions
culture.insight: Law & Liberty, Tuesday: the essay says romanticism has its attractions but is unsuited to the political moment. It argues that insurgents on the left and the right have converged on the same negative rhetoric — against the establishment, the system, elites — while agreeing on almost nothing. Essay, not a poll.
